Convert Table to Kable Format

Source: R/utils_table.R
to_kable.Rd

Converts a data frame or gt table to knitr::kable format for use in R Markdown documents.

Usage

to_kable(
  x,
  format = c("pipe", "markdown", "html", "latex", "rst"),
  digits = 2,
  caption = NULL,
  col.names = NULL,
  row.names = FALSE,
  align = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A data frame, matrix, or gt table to convert.

format

Output format: "markdown", "html", "latex", "rst", "pipe". Default "pipe" for GitHub-flavored markdown.

digits

Number of decimal places for numeric columns. Default 2.

caption

Optional table caption.

col.names

Optional column names (overrides data frame names).

row.names

Logical. Include row names? Default FALSE.

align

Column alignment: "l" (left), "c" (center), "r" (right), or a vector of alignments.

...

Additional arguments passed to knitr::kable.

Value

A knitr_kable object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df <- data.frame(A = 1:3, B = c("x", "y", "z"))
to_kable(df)
to_kable(df, format = "html", caption = "My Table")
} # }
